meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 把一段文字（文章、笔记、主题等）变成一部“无脸解说视频”：没有真人出镜和实拍素材，每幕画面由 AI 按场景设计（排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化）。Claude 会先规划讲解结构，再逐帧搭建，最后渲染出 mp4 视频。
howto.when: 当你说想用一段文字做解说视频，比如给出文章、笔记或主题时触发；也用于概念讲解、如何做、清单类视频。若指网站宣传视频或意图不明，会转去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成一部无脸解说视频。
say.note: Claude 会读取文字，规划教学故事并逐帧生成视频。

say.text: 用这段笔记做一个 60 秒的概念解说，讲清楚光合作用。
say.note: 它会按主题设计画面和旁白，输出视频。

say.text: 把这几个要点做成清单式解说视频，风格简洁一些。
say.note: Claude 会选择合适的视觉预设并开始搭建。

howto.what_en: Turns a piece of text (article, notes, topic, brief) into a 'faceless explainer video': no on-camera talent or footage, visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Claude plans a teaching narrative, builds frame by frame, and renders an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make an explainer video from text, e.g. an article, notes, or a topic; also for concept breakdowns, how-tos, and listicles. If you mean a website promo video or intent is unclear, it routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude reads the text, plans the story, and builds the video frame by frame.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second concept explainer of photosynthesis from these notes.
say_en.note: It designs visuals and narration around the topic and outputs a video.

say_en.text: Turn these bullet points into a clean listicle-style explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude picks a fitting visual preset and starts building.
